shared_elements: lattice / net of crossing diagonal lines
bounded panel or zone of pattern
justification: Both surfaces are covered with incised rectilinear geometry — crossing diagonals forming lattice and hatched triangular fields — rendered schematically without any figures, which is the only real correspondence. But A is a single ordered composition: an arched frame enclosing a distinct diamond-net panel with a vertical central bar and a lower zone with rounded bosses, whereas B is an all-over, irregular patchwork of herringbone-filled triangles and zigzag bands with no framing, no axial element and no compositional focus.
